````{r message=F, warning=F}

library(dittoSeq)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(scran)
library(bluster)
library(TENxPBMCData)

````

# Single-cell RNA-seq in Bioconductor


## Data Loading

````{r}

sce <- TENxPBMCData("pbmc4k")

````

````{r}

head(rowData(sce))


head(colData(sce))

table(sce$Individual)
````

````{r}

rownames(sce)<-rowData(sce)$Symbol_TENx
colnames(sce)<-sce$Barcode
````

## Quality Control

````{r}

is.mito <- grep('^MT-',rownames(sce),value = T)
is.mito



library(scrapper)
df <- perCellQCMetrics(sce, subsets=list(Mito=is.mito))
summary(df$sum)

sce<-quickRnaQc.se(sce,subsets = list(mito=c(is.mito)))

````

````{r}

multi_dittoPlot(sce,c('qc_sum','qc_detected','subset.proportion.mito'),group.by='Individual')

````
````{r}



````

## Dimension Reduction

````{r}

sce<-normalizeRnaCounts.se(sce)
set.seed(1)
sce<-runPca.se(sce, number =50,features =1000)

set.seed(1)
sce<-runTsne.se(sce,reddim.type ='PCA')

````

````{r}



````

````{r}

dittoDimPlot(sce,reduction.use = 'TSNE',c('CD3E','CD163','CD19'))
dittoPlot(sce,c('CD3E','CD163','CD19'),group.by='stim',slot=2)
````
## Clustering

````{r}

sce$nn<-clusterCells(sce,use.dimred = 'PCA', BLUSPARAM=NNGraphParam(k=20,cluster.fun = 'louvain',cluster.args = list(resolution=0.75)))
sce$kmeans<-clusterCells(sce,use.dimred = 'PCA', BLUSPARAM=KmeansParam(centers=10))

dittoDimPlot(sce,reduction.use = 'TSNE','nn')
dittoDimPlot(sce,reduction.use = 'TSNE','kmeans')

````

````{r}

table(sce$cluster,sce$nn)

````

````{r}
genes<-c('CD4_ENSG00000010610','CD3E','CD8A','FCGR3A','CD19','CD79A_ENSG00000105369')

genes %in% rownames(sce)

multi_dittoDimPlot(sce,reduction.use='TSNE',genes)
head(rownames(sce))
````


## Annotation

````{r}

markers<-list(
  T=c('CD3E','CD8A'),
  B=c('CD19','CD79A'),
  NK=c('FCGR3A'),
  Monocyte=c('CD14')
)

````
